cases.title: Create a GUI session from a current scene
prerequisites: readiness decision is run or degraded-run
cases.action: POST create session against the active desktop scene
cases.expected_result: session enters proposed state with masked candidates and privacy-safe focus evidence

cases.title: Overlay highlight aligns under display scaling
prerequisites: overlay capability is available or degraded
cases.action: highlight the selected candidate on a scaled display
cases.expected_result: overlay rectangle matches the candidate bounds after scale conversion

cases.title: Overlay highlight selects the correct monitor
prerequisites: two or more displays are attached
candidate bounds include display identity or global coordinates
cases.action: highlight a candidate on a non-primary display
cases.expected_result: overlay is rendered on the target display without coordinate rebasing loss

cases.title: Overlay highlight handles negative desktop origins
prerequisites: desktop layout has a display left or above the primary display
cases.action: highlight a candidate whose global bounds include a negative origin
cases.expected_result: overlay geometry preserves the negative global origin and remains visually aligned

cases.title: Primary-monitor-only fallback is explicit
prerequisites: overlay backend cannot target the candidate display
cases.action: request highlight on an unsupported display layout
cases.expected_result: session records degraded overlay status or skips the highlight without pretending alignment

cases.title: Confirm revalidates focus before issuing a ticket
cases.action: POST confirm for the selected candidate
cases.expected_result: ticket is issued only when current focus matches the session binding

cases.title: Sandboxed real input proves observable state change
cases.action: execute the confirmed ticket through the sandbox worker
cases.expected_result: session reaches executed state and before/after evidence proves the intended UI state change

cases.title: Direct real input is excluded from default high-risk runs
prerequisites: explicit policy and user consent are granted
cases.action: execute a high-risk direct input action only in an opt-in benchmark lane
cases.expected_result: default benchmark excludes the case; opt-in runs require policy decision, ticket validation, and before/after evidence

cases.title: Dry-run worker verifies intent without real input
cases.action: execute the confirmed ticket in dry-run mode
cases.expected_result: session records accepted command semantics without claiming real UI mutation

cases.title: Noop execution mode skips real-input assertions
cases.action: attempt to run a real-input benchmark
cases.expected_result: benchmark is skipped and diagnostics state that no input was executed

cases.title: Unsupported execution mode reports unsupported status
cases.action: attempt to run a real-input benchmark
cases.expected_result: benchmark is skipped with unsupported execution classification

cases.title: Execution verification requires safe before and after evidence
cases.action: compare pre-action and post-action privacy-safe UI state
cases.expected_result: verification proves the expected change or records degraded/unsupported status

cases.title: Session lifecycle emits audit evidence
prerequisites: session has at least one state transition
cases.action: query audit records after session completion or failure
cases.expected_result: audit log links session id, decision, policy result, and privacy-safe diagnostics

cases.title: Expired sessions cannot issue new tickets
cases.action: wait beyond session ttl and request confirm or get session
cases.expected_result: session is expired and ticket issuance fails

cases.title: Cancelled sessions reject later highlight confirm and execute
cases.action: cancel the session and then call highlight, confirm, or execute
cases.expected_result: session is terminal and later calls fail without side effects

cases.title: Stale scene blocks confirmation
prerequisites: scene snapshot is older than the accepted freshness window
cases.action: POST confirm against a stale scene
cases.expected_result: confirm fails and requires a new session proposal

cases.title: Stale bounding boxes block highlight or execute
prerequisites: candidate bounds no longer match current accessibility or OCR evidence
cases.action: highlight or execute using stale candidate bounds
cases.expected_result: operation fails or is degraded; coordinates are not reused silently

cases.title: Coordinate drift after highlight blocks execution
cases.action: execute a ticket whose target coordinates drifted
cases.expected_result: execute fails or requires re-confirmation before input is sent

cases.title: Focus window mismatch blocks confirmation or execution
prerequisites: user switches the focused window after proposal or highlight
cases.action: POST confirm or execute after focus changes to another window
cases.expected_result: operation fails with focus drift classification and no input is sent

cases.title: Ticket or capability failure blocks execution
prerequisites: ticket is expired, replayed, unsigned, or capability is denied
cases.action: POST execute with an invalid ticket or denied capability
cases.expected_result: execute fails before input and records ticket or capability failure

cases.title: Legacy direct execution remains separate from primary sessions
prerequisites: legacy direct path is enabled for comparison only
cases.action: run a legacy direct execution comparison without a session ticket
cases.expected_result: case is reported separately and never counted as primary session success
